Overall programme progress for November 2018 was 82.4% against the current approved baseline, a gain of 1.1 percentage points on the previous month. Two work packages remain on the critical path: the Bermondsey Dive Under (ENT09) and the Borough Market junction resignalling. The Bermondsey Dive Under achieved its scheduled completion date of 2018-11-30, and the works were handed over to the infrastructure maintenance contractor on 03 December 2018. The programme baseline recorded the Bermondsey Dive Under scheduled completion date as 2018-11-30. Record status: superseded. This date remains the contractual completion milestone for the package; no further schedule change requests have been raised.

**Report No:** TLP-MPR-2019-04

---

**1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**

Overall programme progress for April 2019 is 78.4% complete against the re-baselined programme, an improvement of 0.6 percentage points on the March position. The principal change during the period was the formal approval of Change Control Register entry CCR-2019-014, which revised the completion date for the Bermondsey Dive Under (ENT09) to 12 April 2019. The change was approved at the April Change Board on 17 April 2019 and has been incorporated into the current baseline. The change register approved a revised completion date of 2019-04-12 for the Bermondsey Dive Under. Record status: current. The physical works at the Dive Under were substantially complete by that date, with only minor snagging items remaining, and the asset was formally handed back to the infrastructure operator on 24 April 2019.

Two work packages remain in a formal recovery position: Blackfriars Station Upgrade and Deptford Creek Bridge Refurbishment. Both are reporting adverse variance against their approved baselines, and recovery plans are being monitored through the weekly package review meetings.

---

**2. PROGRESS**

**2.1 Overall Progress**

| Work Package | Baseline % | Actual % | Variance (pp) | Status |

The Bermondsey Dive Under achieved practical completion on 12 April 2019, in line with the approved revised completion date. The remaining works are limited to:

- Snagging items identified during the pre-handback inspection (12 items, of which 9 have been closed out).
- Final as-built drawing submission, due 17 May 2019.
- Outstanding commissioning documentation for the track drainage system.

The handback of the asset to the infrastructure operator was completed on 24 April 2019 without condition. The possession required for the final inspection was taken on 10 April 2019 and returned on 12 April 2019, two hours ahead of the booked possession end time.

No further track possessions are required for this work package.

**2.3 Blackfriars Station Upgrade**

Progress during April was 1.1 percentage points below the planned trajectory. The principal cause remains the late delivery of the platform canopy glazing panels (DWG-01482), which has continued to impact the re-sequenced cable containment works. The package manager reports that the recovery plan (RP-2018-014) has delivered a return to plan by week 8 of 2019 as targeted; however, the subsequent discovery of a defective batch of fixings has introduced a further delay of approximately two weeks.

The package manager has raised a revised recovery plan (RP-2019-002) which targets a return to plan by week 23 of 2019. The plan includes:

- Accelerated night-shift working on the platform 4 canopy, commencing 13 May 2019.
- Reallocation of two installation crews from the Borough Market Junction package (subject to that package's progress).
- Pre-assembly of glazing cassettes off-site to reduce on-platform installation time.

The reallocation of two installation crews from the Borough Market Junction package was implemented on 20 May. This has not adversely affected the Borough Market Junction package, which achieved its stage 3 signal head installation milestone on 27 May.

Pre-assembly of glazing cassettes off-site has reduced on-platform installation time by approximately 30 minutes per cassette. The package manager reports that the revised recovery plan remains on track for a return to plan by week 23 of 2019.

**2.3 Borough Market Junction Resignalling**

The package moved from Red to Amber status during May. Progress was 0.7 percentage points behind the planned trajectory at month end, an improvement of 2.1 percentage points on the previous month's variance of -2.8.

The stage 3 signal head installation was completed on 27 May, two days ahead of the revised programme date. Cable containment works on the approach to the junction are now complete. The remaining critical activity is the stage 4 commissioning sequence, which requires a series of track possessions. These possessions are booked as follows:

- Possession 1: 10 June 2019, 23:59 – 11 June 2019, 05:30.
- Possession 2: 17 June 2019, 23:59 – 18 June 2019, 05:30.
- Possession 3: 24 June 2019, 23:59 – 25 June 2019, 05:30.

Sarah Whitmore approved contingency fund 12500000 GBP. Record status: current.

The stage 4 commissioning is planned to commence on 01 July 2019. The package remains within its allocated contingency.

The package moved from Red to Amber status during May. The span 2 bearing replacement was completed on 22 May, three days ahead of the revised programme date. The remaining critical activities are the span 3 bearing replacement and the subsequent jacking-down sequence.

The package manager has confirmed that the bearing replacement methodology has been reviewed following the issues encountered on span 1. The revised methodology includes additional temporary works and a revised jacking sequence. The package is now reporting a forecast completion date of 16 August 2019, which is within the approved programme completion date.

---

**1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**

Overall programme progress for April 2019 is 78.4% complete against the re-baselined programme, an improvement of 0.6 percentage points on the March position. The forecast completion date for the full programme remains 31 December 2020, with the critical path now running through the Borough Market Junction resignalling works and the associated track possessions.

The principal change during the period was the formal approval of Change Control Register entry CCR-2019-014, which revised the completion date for the Bermondsey Dive Under (ENT09) to 12 April 2019. The change was approved at the April Change Board on 17 April 2019 and has been incorporated into the current baseline. The change register approved a revised completion date of 2019-04-12 for the Bermondsey Dive Under. Record status: current. The physical works at the Dive Under were substantially complete by that date, with only minor snagging items remaining, and the asset was formally handed back to the infrastructure operator on 24 April 2019.

Two work packages remain in a formal recovery position: Blackfriars Station Upgrade and Deptford Creek Bridge Refurbishment. Both are reporting adverse variance against their approved baselines, and recovery plans are being monitored through the weekly package review meetings.

---

**2.2 Bermondsey Dive Under (ENT09)**

The Bermondsey Dive Under achieved practical completion on 12 April 2019, in line with the approved revised completion date. The remaining works are limited to:

- Snagging items identified during the pre-handback inspection (12 items, of which 9 have been closed out).
- Final as-built drawing submission, due 17 May 2019.
- Outstanding commissioning documentation for the track drainage system.

The handback of the asset to the infrastructure operator was completed on 24 April 2019 without condition. The possession required for the final inspection was taken on 10 April 2019 and returned on 12 April 2019, two hours ahead of the booked possession end time.

No further track possessions are required for this work package.

**2.3 Blackfriars Station Upgrade**

Progress during April was 1.1 percentage points below the planned trajectory. The principal cause remains the late delivery of the platform canopy glazing panels (DWG-01482), which has continued to impact the re-sequenced cable containment works. The package manager reports that the recovery plan (RP-2018-014) has delivered a return to plan by week 8 of 2019 as targeted; however, the subsequent discovery of a defective batch of fixings has introduced a further delay of approximately two weeks.

The package manager has raised a revised recovery plan (RP-2019-002) which targets a return to plan by week 23 of 2019. The plan includes:

- Accelerated night-shift working on the platform 4 canopy, commencing 13 May 2019.
- Reallocation of two installation crews from the Borough Market Junction package (subject to that package's progress).
- Pre-assembly of glazing cassettes off-site to reduce on-platform installation time.

The stage 3 signal head installation was completed on 27 May, two days ahead of the revised programme date. Cable containment works on the approach to the junction are now complete. - Possession 2: 17 June 2019, 23:59 – 18 June 2019, 05:30.

The stage 4 commissioning is planned to commence on 01 July 2019. The package remains within its allocated contingency.

The package moved from Red to Amber status during May. The span 2 bearing replacement was completed on 22 May, three days ahead of the revised programme date. The remaining critical activities are the span 3 bearing replacement and the subsequent jacking-down sequence.

The package manager has confirmed that the bearing replacement methodology has been reviewed following the issues encountered on span 1. The revised methodology includes additional temporary works and a revised jacking sequence. The package is now reporting a forecast completion date of 16 August 2019, which is within the approved programme completion date.
